source_title: Elizabeth Taylor’s Goddaughter Shows Close-Up Look at the Late Actress’ Jewels - People.com
source_excerpt:
Victoria Brynner, daughter of Doris Brynner, shared rare photos of Taylor’s famous jewelry
Anwar Hussein/Getty; Victoria Brynner/Instagram; Patrice PICOT/Gamma-Rapho via Getty
Elizabeth Taylor’s goddaughter Victoria Brynner shared photos of the late actress’ jewelry archives in an Instagram post published on Thursday, Oct. 29
Brynner, a former model, posted snapshots of her children wearing Taylor’s iconic jewelry in 2011, the year the Cleopatra star died at age 79
Her post came a day after Kim Kardashian shared a video of herself wearing Taylor’s emerald and diamond Bulgari necklace during the All’s Fair press tour
Elizabeth Taylor ‘s jewels are more than a glimmer of sparkle.
Victoria Brynner, who is the daughter of the late Doris Brynner and Oscar winner Yul Brynner, shared an Instagram post on Thursday, Oct. 29, showing a never-before-seen and close-up look at Taylor’s jewelry archives, which recently made headlines after one of her Bulgari pieces was worn by Kim Kardashian .
“It’s funny when objects that you know so well from people who were so close to you end up being discussed in the news a lot,” began Victoria in the caption of her post, which included pictures of her kids wearing the Cleopatra actress’ jewelry, including rings, a tiara and the very neckpiece Kardashian wore during her All’s Fair press tour in Rome.
The same piece was previously seen on Julianne Moore in 2013.
“These were amazing pieces, and I was lucky enough in 2011 to photograph my children wearing them. Enjoy! Elizabeth Taylor forever,” she added.
The goliath diamond ring also seen in Brynner’s carousel appeared to be the famous 33.19-carat Krupp diamond, which Taylor received from her fifth husband Richard Burton ; the stone was named after the Hollywood icon after she died on March 23, 2011 of congestive heart failure at 79.
Taylor’s collection of jewelry , including a 19th-century diamond tiara from husband Mike Todd , sold for more than $137 million at auction. She had previously sold the 69.42-carat Taylor-Burton diamond —which Burton initially bought for $1.1 million for her 40th birthday — for a reported $5 million, and used some of the proceeds to build a hospital in Botswana.
Victoria was the goddaughter of Taylor, as well as Audrey Hepburn , who was Doris’ best friend.
Taylor’s bold fashion taste returned to the zeitgeist with Kardashian’s Hulu law drama All’s Fair , which includes a scene of her dressed in Taylor’s famous Tiziani Roma Scorpio cape. The sartorially significant piece was first worn in 1969 and most recently seen on by Kris Jenner at the season premiere in Rome this October.
“After Ryan Murphy heard the story of Elizabeth Taylor wearing it to Grace Kelly ‘s Scorpion Ball, naturally, he made sure to write an episode about Allura Grant throwing her own Scorpion Ball,” Kardashian wrote on Instagram. “I’m the luckiest girl to have borrowed it from my mom.”

In another Instagram post, the SKIMS founder also said she was able to get an even more intimate look at Taylor’s archives many years ago. “When she passed away, I was brought into her home [and] shown her safe with all of her jewelry before they cleared it out,” Kardashian said while visiting Bulgari in the clip.
“So, I was able to see everything in her home and her jewelry still in her safe and all of her stuff still [there], her furniture,” she added. “I was able to go in there like right after she passed. I know that sounds insane, but I was able to see this stuff in her purple closet.”
Kardashian shared that she “was lucky enough to have a phone conversation with” Taylor about the emerald and diamond necklace before she died 15 years ago.
